headline: Fee waivers and credits, a food pantry request, a flag football tournament, and field changes at McNamara and Finn fields.
summary: The meeting covers rain-out fee credits, a Free Little Pantry at Fort Hill Park, and field and pavilion rentals. It also covers a refund request, a fundraiser, a bike race cancellation, and an outstanding fee report.
items: Sabeeh Ehsan requests credits for rain-outs: September 13th for $100, September 20 for $75, September 26 for $50, and September 27 for $100.
Ava Spies requests permission to start a Free Little Pantry at Fort Hill Park in the Rogers Fort Hill / Belvidere area.
Catherine Apollo requests a refund for the cancelled September 26th event. The group was told before the event.
Joseph Bova requests adult flag football at Gage Field Gage I and Gage Field Gage II on Sunday, November 29, 2026, 10am-2pm. Resident adult fee is $25.00 per 2-hour block x 4 = $100.00. Total $100.

Larry Benjamin requests a flag football tournament at South Common - Purtell Multipurpose Field on Friday, November 27, 2026, 9am-5pm. Tournament fee is $225 per field per day. Total $225. Maximum 100 people.

Hamim Hasan requests a fundraiser for LHS at Shedd Park Pavilion on Sunday, November 8, 2026, 12pm-4pm. Resident youth fee is $0.00 per 4-hour block. Custodial fee is $200 per 4-hour block. Total fee $200.
Joe Cady requests cancellation of bike races and waiver of the unpaid fee on his account.

Adrianna Paquin requests a birthday party at Shedd Park Pavilion on Sunday, November 29, 2026, 1pm-5pm. Resident youth fee is $0.00 per 4-hour block. Custodial fee is $200 per 4-hour block. Total fee $200.
Matt LeLacheur of LYBSL requests two actions: A) donate the cost of renovations at McNamara Field, and B) convert Finn Field to a multipurpose field for baseball and softball.
location: Mayor's Reception Room, 375 Merrimack St. 2nd Floor, Lowell, MA 01852
